EUR.EUR/USD: EUR/USD trades within a tight range following the European Central Bank's decision to deliver a 25-basis-point interest rate increase to 2.65%. Broad greenback resilience continues to dominate price action under Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh, while precious metals headlines note that Silver’s $60 floor should hold unless gold breaks first. German ZEW sentiment edged up to 34.7, though Eurozone expectations fell to 25.8 alongside a collapsing year-to-date trade surplus cushion. The ECB has a rate hike fully priced in for October 29 while the Fed remains on hold ahead of its September 16 policy decision
